primary_population: all SOP predictions against full original ground truth; datasheets excluded from FP
assignment: same document only; Hungarian; maximize valid pair count, then sum of valid cosine similarities; invalid pairs contribute zero
class_auxiliary: retain primary matching; equal-class pairs count as TP, all other predictions/GT count FP/FN
sensor_auxiliary: exact sensor set equality for content-matched pairs with interpretable sensor fields; missing GT sensor field is N/A
null_text_policy: null condition/action becomes empty string; no invented replacement text
gold_document_policy: source must equal a manifest document ID, original path, or original PDF filename (case-insensitive basename); otherwise stop
gold_access: evaluation code only in this output's src/imaks_kg/eval/; never print gold rule text to chat
actual_model_verification: unverified; do not change frozen provenance
exposure: project has historical gold exposure; schema and attached definitions contain counts/metadata; this is development evaluation, not independent blind test
